info.title: VSX_Remote_Interface
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [VSX_Remote_Interface](#/VSX_Remote_Interface)
List of interfaces on the VSX peer device which are part of same LAG. [VSX_Remote_Interface](#/VSX_Remote_Interface)

admin_state.description: The administrative state of the physical network link.

duplex.description: The duplex mode of the physical network link.

lacp_actor_port_id.description: Peer interface's LACP actor port ID. If there is no remote partner value will be empty.

lacp_actor_port_priority.description: Peer interface's LACP actor port priority. If there is no remote partner value will be empty.

Active.description: This value when set to `true` indicates an actor is active. When set to `false` indicates an actor is passive.

Aggregable.description: This value when set to `true` indicates an actor is aggregable with partner. When set to `false` indicates an actor is individual.

Collecting.description: This value when set to `true` indicates an actor is collecting.

Default_neighbor_state.description: This value when set to `true` indicates an actor is with default neighbour state.

Distributing.description: This value when set to `true` indicates an actor is distributing.

In_sync.description: This value when set to `true` indicates an actor is in-sync with partner. When set to `false` indicates an actor is out-of-sync with partner.

Short_timeout.description: This value when set to `true` indicates an actor is configured with short-timeout. When set to `false` indicates an actor is configured with long-timeout.

State_machine_expired.description: This value when set to `true` indicates an actor's state machine is expired.

lacp_actor_system_id.description: Peer interface's LACP actor system ID. If there is no remote partner value will be empty.

lacp_actor_system_priority.description: Peer interface's LACP actor system priority. If there is no remote partner value will be empty.

lacp_partner_port_id.description: Peer interface's LACP partner port ID. If there is no remote partner, value will be empty.

lacp_partner_port_priority.description: Peer interface's LACP partner port priority. If there is no remote partner value will be empty.

Active.description: This value when set to `true` indicates partner is active. When set to `false` indicates partner is passive.

Aggregable.description: This value when set to `true` indicates partner is aggregable with an actor. When set to `false` indicates partner is individual.

Collecting.description: This value when set to `true` indicates partner is collecting.

Default_neighbor_state.description: This value when set to `true` indicates partner is with default neighbour state.

Distributing.description: This value when set to `true` indicates partner is distributing.

In_sync.description: This value  when set to `true` indicates partner is in-sync with an actor. When set to `false` indicates partner is out-of-sync with an actor.

Short_timeout.description: This value when set to `true` indicates partner is configured with short-timeout. When set to `false` indicates partner is configured with long-timeout.

State_machine_expired.description: This value  when set to `true` indicates partner's state machine is expired.

lacp_partner_system_id.description: Peer interface's LACP partner system ID. If there is no remote partner value will be empty.

lacp_partner_system_priority.description: Peer interface's LACP partner system priority. If there is no remote partner value will be empty.

link_speed.description: The negotiated speed of the physical network link in bits per second. Valid values are positive integers greater than 0.

link_state.description: The observed state of the physical network link. This is ordinarily the link's carrier status.

name.description:
Reference Resource: [VSX_Remote_Interface](#/VSX_Remote_Interface)
Name of the peer interface.

parameters.name: Interface.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The port name. For non-bonded ports, the port name is the same as the associated interface name. The name must otherwise be unique across all ports and interfaces of the system.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
